editorial:
If you like twisty horror with nasty traps and a big mystery, this one keeps the pressure on. Detective Hoffman is now running Jigsaw's deadly games, but the FBI is getting close, so he has to move fast. The main game targets a health insurance boss who denies coverage, and the story ties back to Jigsaw's past. It feels mean, tense, and full of puzzles, with that familiar Saw style of dark rooms, timers, and hard choices. You do not need to love every sequel to follow the main idea, but knowing the earlier films helps.

The acting is solid, especially the villain energy and the stressed-out victims. The traps are creative and gross without feeling random, and the pacing stays quick. Some scenes are very bloody, and the plot can feel crowded if you are new. Fans of the series will enjoy the answers and the final payoff. If you want a dark thriller night, stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you learn Jill, Jigsaw's wife, was part of John's plan all along. She confronts Hoffman and locks a reverse bear trap on his head, then leaves him to die. Hoffman barely escapes with a brutal injury, proving Jigsaw's game is not over. The movie ends with him wounded but alive, ready for revenge, while the FBI case against him grows stronger and his secret is exposed.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark horror sequels with traps and twists.
